subject: Two-day immersion at Redwood HQ — room mapping, escort, and NDA (please confirm)
messages:
From: Tim Hsu <tim.hsu@solventa.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@solventa.com>, Solventa Operations <ops@solventa.com>
Date: 2025-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood HQ visit — request to lock two-day program

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. The exec team at Solventa would like to come to Redwood HQ for a two-day immersion the week of Aug 18 — one full day of demos and a second half day for integration planning and exec Q&A.

High-level asks:
- Main demo (room for 25, projector + hybrid video)
- Breakout rooms (2 small rooms for technical deep dives)
- NDA on file and signed by both parties before arrival
- Badges for 10 visitors and one contractor escort

Can you confirm availability for Aug 19–20 and who from Redwood will own the run-of-show? We can share a preliminary attendee list once dates are locked.

Appreciate it — Tim
Director of Product, Solventa
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tim Hsu <tim.hsu@solventa.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood HQ visit — request to lock two-day program

Hi Tim — great to hear and excited to host.

Quick answers:
- Aug 19 (full day) + Aug 20 (half day) currently looks available for the Redwood Demo Center + two breakouts. I'll reserve the Demo Center and request AV support.
- Marissa will own logistics and badging (cc'd). Dylan will run the primary demo and tech deep-dive.
- Please attach the signed NDA; I can upload to our compliance queue and circulate to Security for records.

Could you send the attendee names and any dietary restrictions by Aug 5 so we can set badges and catering? Also: any laptop access requirements for the breakout sessions (docker images, VM access)?

I'll send a proposed run-of-show and room map by Friday.

Thanks,
Priya
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@solventa.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-07-16T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood HQ visit — request to lock two-day program

On Wed, Jul 16, 2025 at 11:05 AM Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Tim — great to hear and excited to host.
> 
> Quick answers: ...

Thanks, Priya. NDA attached (signed by Solventa legal). We prefer the team to arrive the morning of Aug 19 and depart midday Aug 20.

Attendee names (finalizing but here are ten):
- Tim Hsu (Director)
- Elena Cruz (Ops)
- Marcus Lee (CTO)
- Sarah N. (Sr. Eng)
- Ravi Patel (SRE)
- Ana Gomez (PM)
- Jorge Ruiz (QA)
- Priya S. (Data)

Best,
Elena
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Solventa Operations <ops@solventa.com>
Date: 2025-07-17T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood HQ visit — room bookings and badging

Folks — looping in Facilities (Monica) to confirm rooms. Action items I will take:
- Reserve Demo Center (Main A) for Aug 19 full day and Aug 20 morning
- Book Breakout B and C from 09:00–12:30 on Aug 19
- AV: confirm hybrid cabling + one laptop dock + spare dongles
- Catering: morning coffee + boxed lunches for Aug 19, light snacks Aug 20
- Badge list: please send CSV by Aug 5 (Ben Rowe needs contractor vendor name + ID type)

Monica — can you confirm whether escorts must be Redwood employees or if security can process a temporary contractor badge for CourseIT? Also I attached a first-draft Run_of_Show for comment.

Attachments: Run_of_Show_Day1_v2.xlsx

Thanks — Marissa
Sr. Program Manager, Customer Events
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Solventa Operations <ops@solventa.com>
Date: 2025-07-19T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood HQ visit — final confirmations and badge checklist

Marissa / Priya — quick operational confirm before I close the tickets:
- Rooms: Demo Center Main A reserved Aug 19 08:00–17:30 and Aug 20 08:00–13:00. Breakouts B & C reserved Aug 19 09:00–12:30.
- AV: Hybrid setup scheduled; Dylan, please share your USB-C adapter list by Aug 8 so we can stage dongles.
- Badging: we can issue temporary contractor badges if CourseIT provides a state ID and vendor affiliation. Escort is required for contractors — recommend one Redwood escort per 5 visitors.
- NDA: uploaded to Compliance (file: Solventa_NDA-exec-signed.pdf). Security will keep a copy.
- Parking: 3 visitor passes (garage level 2) will be available at Reception; ops@solventa.com let us know if you need shuttle coordination.

Final ask to Solventa: please confirm attendee CSV and identify Ben Rowe's ID type (driver's license or passport) by Aug 5. Once I have that I will provide the badge CSV and finalize catering.

Thanks — Monica
Facilities Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
